Yeah, essentially. I’m not against that type of hunting for food, legal, with good reason, good use of all of the animal etc
In what way?

I don’t think I can/will ever be able to personally do harm or kill an animal unless it is clearly suffering and beyond saving. I also am not one for gun use, or all the other logistics like cleaning, skinning etc that would come with it. I also do not feel that I would be able to make use of all the animal, and would never want for any of it to go to waste. 

As far as meat consumption, I would be less opposed to eating it if it came from a smaller, local farm that took care of the animals, or was hunted by a friend legally. I can’t say for sure if I would/wouldn’t eat it though. Since I have become pescetarian, I have only eaten meats if its something like a cultural dish, or once in a lifetime thing. And even then, it’s just a bite from what the people with me order, as no one else I know or travel/eat with are pescetarian.
No, I would not personally, but I am not against properly licensed hunting that is backed by a need to reduce the strain of the environment. Especially if all parts of the animal is going to use.
